services.name: Apgar Village Bear Spray & Gear Rentals
services.desc: Glacier National Park is a premier bear stronghold, home to the highest density of grizzly bears in the lower 48 and a thriving population of over 600 black bears. Because you are sharing the trails with nearly 1,000 bears, carrying bear spray is your most essential safety tool. Online Availability Closes 24 hours in advance, please text us to book for 24 hours or less before rental start

services.name: Apgar Village Camp & Hike Rentals
services.desc: From day hikes to backcountry camping, we have the gear you need to explore Glacier National Park safely and comfortably. All equipment is well-maintained and from trusted brands like Osprey, MSR, Grizzly, and Jetboil. Online Availability Closes 24 hours in advance, please text us to book for 24 hours or less before rental start time Pickup your gear anytime open to close, regardless of booking

services.name: Going-to-the-Sun Road Bike Adventure (April-June)
services.desc: Each spring, before vehicles are allowed, cyclists and hikers gain exclusive access to the breathtaking Going to the Sun Road—one of the top bike rides in the world. Ride past towering peaks, rushing waterfalls, and endless alpine views without a car in sight! This is a bucket-list adventure you don't want to miss! Online Availability Closes 24 hours in advance, please text us to book for the next 24 hours This bike rental is for the early season when Going to the Sun Road is closed to vehicles and only allows hikers and bikers. Pickup begins at 7:00am and bikes are due bike no later than 7:00pm. DON'T FORGET YOUR BIKE RACKS OR SHUTTLE

services.name: Kayak/SUP Reservations
services.desc: Online Availability Closes 24 hours in advance, please text us to book if less than 24 hours in advance We are a short walk to Lake McDonald and provide you with wheels or a cart to walk the kayak/SUP to the lake. Dry Bags are available on a first-come-first-serve basis on the day of your rental. Cancelation Policy: Reservations are not canceled for fog, rain, or a chilly day. We will cancel if the conditions are not suitable for paddling or biking (lightning, strong winds, or extreme weather). Cancellations made at least 3 days prior to the trip will receive a full refund. Canceling with 24 hours' notice or more will be able to transfer payment to a future trip or program. Cancellations

blurb: Glacier Outfitters rents high-end, well-maintained gear for adventures in Glacier National Park. They offer rentals for bikes, kayaks, paddleboards, bear spray, hiking and camping gear, and fishing rods. They have two convenient locations: Apgar Village inside the park and Glacier Park International Airport for gear pickup.
